reviews.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended Tool-call turns can emit follow-up answers before text in the final chunk, producing out-of-order responses in both OpenAIChat and GeminiAIChat.
1 open issue - [Yield text before handling tool calls to preserve response order](https://github.com/LLPhant/LLPhant/pull/554#discussion_r4622192088) · New
What changed in this PR This PR addresses truncated streamed responses in LLPhant’s OpenAI and Gemini chat adapters by preserving text sent in the final chunk. **Changes:** - Yield non-empty chunk content before stopping on a finish reason in both adapters. - Add regression tests confirming that final-chunk text appears in the complete streamed response. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​Unit/​Chat/​OpenAIChatTest.php` | Adds final-chunk text regression tests for both adapters. | | `src/​Chat/​OpenAIChat.php` | Emits chunk content before checking the finish reason. | | `src/​Chat/​GeminiAIChat.php` | Applies the same content-before-stop ordering to Gemini streams. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: If a tool-call turn's final chunk also contains text, the branch above yields the follow-up answer before that text, producing `Hello<follow-up answer> world`. Move the content-yield block before the tool-handling branch to preserve response order. Same issue in `src/Chat/GeminiAIChat.php:141–143` for tool turns ending with `stop`.
